series.description:
Long format: one row per (bucket, group), oldest bucket first within a group, groups ranked by
run count. Ungrouped, it is simply one row per bucket.

failure_rate.description: A percentage in 0-100, not a fraction: 2 means 2%.

group_id.description: The group's ID, where the dimension has one; absent otherwise.

workflow.description: Group labels. Exactly one is set, matching meta.group_by; all absent when ungrouped.

truncated.description: Whether groups were dropped to satisfy the limit. Always false ungrouped.

400.description: a required parameter is missing, or a value is malformed

code.description: ERR_VALIDATION when a required parameter is missing; absent on a malformed value.

details.description: The missing parameters, one entry each; absent on a malformed value.

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong.

401.description: the Authorization header is missing or malformed

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong. Not a stable contract - branch on the status.

402.description: the workspace has no paid Insights plan

code.description: A stable identifier to branch on.

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong.
message.example: the Insights API requires a paid Insights plan

403.description: the token is rejected, or has no access to this workspace or project

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong. Not a stable contract - branch on the status.

422.description: a parameter value is outside its accepted set or range

code.description: A stable identifier to branch on.

details.description: The offending parameters, one entry each.

message.description: The rule the value broke, naming the accepted values or bounds.
message.example: Field BuildSeriesRequest.Granularity failed on: oneof (hourly daily weekly monthly)

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong.

429.description: rate limit exceeded; a plain text body of 'Too Many Requests', with a Retry-After header and the X-RateLimit-* headers

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong. Not a stable contract - branch on the status.

503.description: authorization is temporarily unavailable; the request may be retried

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong. Not a stable contract - branch on the status.
